versions.changelog:
- Major update: refocused skill from a reseller/payment API key flow to a direct CrawlHub data extraction integration.
- Removed all ETH payment/reselling logic and references.
- Updated description to highlight full social media & messaging platform coverage (X/Twitter, Instagram, Telegram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, etc.).
- Detailed API authentication, core endpoints, execution, and error handling for the main CrawlHub REST API.
- Replaced resale/payment instructions with pricing model, endpoint discovery, and common use case documentation.
- Removed reseller-specific files and technical artifacts; now a general-purpose data extraction skill.

Initial release of crawlhub-reseller skill, enabling automated ETH-based sales of CrawlHub API keys for Twitter/X crawling.

- Verifies customer wallet ownership via Ethereum signature.
- Confirms on-chain ETH payment through Etherscan.
- Delivers API key and complete CrawlHub API documentation upon successful verification.
- Provides pricing (0.010 ETH/24h), payment address, and clear customer request/response flows.
- Exposes A2A-compatible API endpoints for agent integration.
